tasks.title: Close RT-J3-O8 through RT-J3-O12: operation/host binding, recursive PB-3, executable CT semantics, dependent-action registry

handoff.objective: Author one additive static successor contract, j3-closure-v5.yaml, that closes exactly RT-J3-O8 through RT-J3-O12 from coordination/goals/GOAL-ENDO-001/batches/BATCH-718595/reviews/TASK-20260824-4927cd/red-team-report.yaml, and one control-rerun-v5.yaml that reruns the existing 81-control matrix plus five new named controls, all as zero-run static declarative fixtures.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the five remaining J3 procedural/schema escapes admit a closed, mechanically checkable schema without hidden authorization.
inputs: RT-J3-O8 through RT-J3-O12 exact findings and required_repair text
constraints: Do not edit any BATCH-718595 or earlier byte; this is an additive successor file set only.

operation_effect_class must be a single closed enum containing the five existing host_resource_effect_classes plus exactly one explicit non-host value (e.g. none_no_host_effect); every other value is rejected. requested_action=inspect_static must resolve to the non-host value, never to STOP-by-omission.

The active host/filesystem binding used by the validity check must be sourced only from the current task's own immutable runtime-session-receipt.json (an authoritative field emitted by the runtime harness at session start), never from the caller-supplied host_observation object; state this sourcing rule explicitly and STOP if the receipt field is absent.

PB-3 closure must be fully recursive: every nested model key (serialization_model, merge_model, residual_artifact_grouping, unit_conversions, conservativeness_basis) gets its own closed key/value schema with exact-key-equality enforced at that nesting level, not only at the top level. Every formula operand referenced by retained_bytes, largest_artifact_bytes, shard_count, and logical_io_bytes (retained_terms, residual_artifact_bytes, individual_artifact_terms, read_bytes, write_bytes, replay_bytes) must appear as a typed, unit-bound, capped allowed_term or be explicitly bound to the resource-envelope schema; no formula may consume an operand absent from this closure.

Resource composition must define, for every one of CT-1 through CT-5, an explicit per-control formula mapping its raw record count and bootstrap_resamples to bytes/CPU/wall/memory/disk, an aggregation rule from per-control to total values that states its scheduling/concurrency model in words (e.g. sequential within a control, concurrent across controls up to max_concurrent), a total bootstrap_resamples cap bounding the sum across every bootstrap-using control, and an explicit inequality comparing host free_disk_bytes/memory_bytes against predicted demand, with violation STOP.

CT-1 through CT-5 must each get a complete per-record schema (trial_id, pair_key, seed, signal_value, null_value, is_duplicate, event) with an explicit per-CT event predicate; CT-3's interval algorithm must be named to one specific closed-form construction with its endpoints defined, not merely named; the bootstrap must pin its PRNG algorithm, resampling unit (one paired trial row), index/duplicate handling, and percentile interpolation method; CT-4 must define wall_rate as inputs_processed / wall_seconds and require wall_seconds > 0; CT-5 must define destroyed_effect and destroyed_null_effect as explicitly signed (not absolute) quantities and state that the predicate operates on the signed value.

The dependent-action registry must be a single closed enum covering every scheduler, control, measurement, interpretation, resource-admission, and authorization-transition action name used anywhere in this contract chain (at minimum: fit, pass, resource_approval, materialization, schedule, dispatch, implementation, disposition, control_execution, instrument_execution, measurement, interpretation, envelope_admission, authorization_transition), and any action label outside this enum must itself be an immediate STOP before dispatch.

control-rerun-v5.yaml must re-evaluate every one of the 81 known-false/edge fixtures from the BATCH-718595 red-team report's static_control_count against the new j3-closure-v5.yaml schema and record each outcome, plus exactly five new named controls: a nested-PB3 escape control placing an unlisted term inside merge_model (expected STOP), a zero-baseline CT-4 control with cpu_seconds_baseline=0 or wall_seconds_baseline=0 (expected STOP), a CT-5 signedness control showing the signed and absolute readings diverge and only the signed reading is accepted, an unlisted-action control requesting a dependent action label outside the closed enum while PB-3 state is unknown (expected STOP before dispatch), and a host-binding-forgery control supplying a caller-shaped host/filesystem identity not sourced from the runtime-session-receipt (expected STOP).

This is static contract authoring only: no experiment, control run, instrument access, target or curve access, JINV, transport, N18, network write, or scientific interpretation. All authorization fields in the deliverable must be false or zero.

Explicitly flag, rather than silently resolve, whether the 'authoritative host binding sourced from the runtime harness' is actually enforceable given this repair chain has no live runtime harness to source it from, or is only a specifiable rule pending that harness. State this as a named limitation in the deliverable; do not present it as fully closed if it is not.
completion_gate: All five RT-J3-O8 through RT-J3-O12 objections map to explicit closed fields with no unresolved schema gap other than the disclosed harness-binding limitation.
PB-3 closure and resource composition are recursive and compositional, not top-level-only.
CT-1 through CT-5 have unique, executable, per-CT statistical semantics.
The dependent-action registry is closed with unknown-action global STOP.
The 81-control matrix plus the five new named controls are all rerun with recorded expected/observed outcomes.
No authorization field is anything other than false or zero.
